about.summary: Bobby Flennoy is a CS and Neuroscience student at UT Arlington (B.S. CS + Neuroscience minor, expected Aug 2026). He works at the intersection of code and cognition, building AI systems that adapt to humans rather than forcing humans to adapt to the machine.

experience.summary: Bobby has three main work experiences: (1) AI Research & Full-Stack Developer at Pearl Discovery (nonprofit, Mar 2026–Present) — built a Next.js platform from scratch, fine-tuned a small language model that cut API costs by 90%, used Supabase/PostgreSQL/Vercel. (2) UX Research Intern at CBRE (Jun–Aug 2025) — built AI-driven feature prioritization workflow for 500+ users, ran live-edit prototype sessions during user interviews using Figma and Figma Make, used MaxDiff analysis and Likert surveys. (3) HCI Researcher at Hybrd Atelier Lab, UT Arlington (May–Aug 2024) — investigated GenAI's effect on creativity in 3D fabrication, used card sorting, ethnography, ontology design, GPT-4 API.

ux_process.summary: Bobby's UX process is hands-on and AI-augmented: he runs user interviews, builds functional prototypes in real-time during sessions so users can 'live-edit' designs with him, uses MaxDiff analysis to prioritize features based on real friction points, and applies journey mapping and Likert surveys. He closes the insight-to-code gap by using AI to accelerate from research findings to working prototypes. Tools: Figma, Figma Make, usability testing, rapid prototyping.

skills.summary: Technical skills: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, TailwindCSS, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Vercel, Claude API, GPT-4 API, SLM fine-tuning, sentiment analysis. UX/Research skills: Figma, Figma Make, user interviews, usability testing, rapid prototyping, journey mapping, MaxDiff analysis, Likert surveys, card sorting, ethnography, ontology design, wireframing.

education.summary: Bobby studies at the University of Texas at Arlington. B.S. Computer Science (Algorithms & Data Structures, AI, OOP, Databases, HCI, Software Project Management) with a Neuroscience minor (Cognitive Processes, Brain & Behavior, Behavioral Genetics, Intro to Psychology). Expected graduation August 2026.

extracurriculars.summary: Bobby is President & Student Advisor of ACM at UTA (200+ members, 3x membership growth). He was Creative Director of HackUTA (600+ attendees, led creative team of 8). He was an invited speaker at WeHacks (300+ audience, talked on AI-native design). He won 1st place at HackUTD (400+ participants, 80+ teams, built AI product in 24 hours).
